description: Extension and alterations to roof of existing garage; conversion of garage to habitable room / storage; external alterations
decision_conditions: The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans and documents: A26-21-01
The materials and brick bond to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

<p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-bottom:0cm;line-height:normal;mso-layout-grid-align:
none;text-autospace:none"><span style="font-family: Arial, sans-serif;">Notwithstanding
the plans hereby approved, the original timber swing garage doors on site shall
be retained in situ on the outbuilding, to remain visible in front of any
brickwork installed behind them. These shall be retained as such thereafter.<o:p></o:p></span></p>

<p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-bottom:0cm;line-height:normal;mso-layout-grid-align:
none;text-autospace:none"><span style="font-family: Arial, sans-serif;">The
upper level of brickwork to the outbuilding shall be laid as brick on edge
detailing.<o:p></o:p></span></p>

<p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-bottom:0cm;line-height:normal;mso-layout-grid-align:
none;text-autospace:none">The
outbuilding hereby permitted shall not be occupied at any time other than for
purposes ancillary to the residential use of the dwelling.<font face="Arial, sans-serif"><o:p></o:p></font></p>
